gaps.title: Personality Governance owner convergence
gaps.description: A narrow owner can be defined entirely within this planning directory.

gaps.title: Trait candidate schema
gaps.description: All required candidate fields and false activation flags are locally specified.

gaps.title: Profile candidate schema
gaps.description: Non-flattened multi-trait profile semantics are locally specified.

gaps.title: Trait taxonomy
gaps.description: The required multidimensional candidate taxonomy is locally specified.

gaps.title: Stability and admission
gaps.description: Evidence diversity, temporal span, contradiction, counterexample, and correction rules are locally specified.

gaps.title: Revision lineage
gaps.description: Revision, supersession, revocation, and expiration contracts are locally specified.

gaps.title: Cross-owner boundary contracts
gaps.description: Self, Memory, Learning, Emotion, Regulation, PCN, and Intent boundaries are locally specified.

gaps.title: Privacy sensitivity
gaps.description: Seven sensitivity levels and transfer/generalization restrictions are locally specified.

gaps.title: Trace and provenance
gaps.description: Reverse lookup and lineage preservation are locally specified.

gaps.title: Idempotency
gaps.description: Duplicate and replay guards are locally specified.

gaps.title: Synthetic scenario suite
gaps.description: P01-P36 cover required personality boundaries and deferred semantics.

gaps.title: Planning-only verifier contract
gaps.description: Static artifact checks can be verified without runtime or existing-module mutation.

gaps.title: Self-to-Personality typed adapter
gaps.description: Future Self Governance contract should formalize Personality Evidence Candidate handoff.

gaps.title: Memory-to-Personality evidence adapter
gaps.description: Future Memory/Experience contract should define scoped behavior and emotional-experience evidence references.

gaps.title: Learning-to-Personality evolution adapter
gaps.description: Future Learning contract should formalize long-term tendency, contradiction, and counterexample handoff.

gaps.title: Emotion-to-Personality evidence interface
gaps.description: Future Emotion Governance must define context-bound emotion evidence without trait mutation.

gaps.title: Regulation-pattern evidence adapter
gaps.description: Future Regulation contract should distinguish long-term pattern evidence from parameter semantics.

gaps.title: PCN context scope adapter
gaps.description: Future PCN contract should expose role/relationship/interaction scope without global generalization.

gaps.title: Intent context adapter
gaps.description: Future Intent contract should define intent-linked personality evidence without intent mutation.

gaps.title: User correction protocol
gaps.description: Future user-facing contract should define confirmation/correction UX and audit semantics.

gaps.title: Historical Self Layer owner drift
gaps.description: Old Self Layer/Social Self Layer personality growth naming conflicts with the single Personality Governance owner.

gaps.title: Legacy personality runtime recipes
gaps.description: Production recipes and monitors imply runtime/tuning semantics, not candidate governance.

gaps.title: Historical personality fingerprint semantics
gaps.description: The fingerprint is useful as non-semantic evidence but cannot be a Personality owner or truth score.

gaps.title: Social role as personality owner
gaps.description: Role and relationship assets are contextual and cannot be promoted to global personality ownership.

gaps.title: Single personality score
gaps.description: Flattened scoring conflicts with multidimensional, contradictory, candidate-only profile semantics.

gaps.title: Existing module mutation shortcut
gaps.description: No existing Self, Memory, Learning, Regulation, PCN, or Intent module may be edited to resolve Personality gaps.

gaps.title: Affective memory compression

gaps.title: Persistent profile storage
gaps.description: Deferred; no database/vector/embedding execution.
